# NH 44 Indian

> NH 44 Indian, located at 219 E. Hartsdale Ave, Hartsdale, NY, offers a wide range of traditional Indian dishes. The restaurant features tandoori specialties, rich curries, aromatic biryanis, and various vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

## Menu
Offers a wide range of traditional Indian dishes, including tandoori specialties, rich curries, aromatic biryanis, and various vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.
